title: Generation config merging logic prevents explicit override of model-specific defaults back to global defaults
author: albertvillanova

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body: Yep, the merging logic was not perfect and we had no better option at the time while keeping backwards compatibility. I am removing the whole "merging" in https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/42702 and instead changing the defaults to `None`. That way we don't have to guess if a value of `1` is from defaults or explicitly set by users

comments.author: qgallouedec
comments.body:
I would like to escalate on this issue, which I think is very important. RL training is very sensitive to sampling parameters, especially temperature, which is set to 1.0 by default. In the past, we have had some fairly visible shit storm because of this kind of silent problem:

https://x.com/kalomaze/status/1926751357983154606

Let's try to merge it quickly 🙏

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body: Btw, it will go in v5 as the PR is quite breaking. I don't see a way to fix it so we can add in patch release. There are too many edge cases with default values

comments.author: albertvillanova
comments.body:
Thanks a lot, @zucchini-nlp! 🤗 
We are working on a fix in TRL for previous transformers versions:
